Notably, the underlying abstracts do address the same drug (liraglutide 1.8 mg, ~26 weeks, DXA-measured lean mass in overweight T1D adults) but diverge on the drug effect itself (side a: lean mass -2.5 kg with liraglutide, between-group P < 0.001; side b: no change in lean mass) - however, side a's selected claim does not capture that liraglutide-arm result, so this discrepancy is not what the extracted claims compare. Side b's estimate_direction '+' for 'conserving lean body mass' is an interpretive framing of the source's 'no change in lean mass'; it does not affect the comparability verdict here."}}
